description: Normalized profile of one entity: label, description, aliases, types, official identifiers (LEI, ticker, VIAF, OpenCorporates, national registers ...), and the core facts for its kind (inception, country, headquarters, website, founders, CEO, employees and revenue over time, industry, population, licence, version ...). Every fact keeps rank, qualifiers (start, end, point in time), reference count and a status: observed, observed_unsourced, historical, deprecated or conflicting. Extra properties on request. Price: 0.004 USDC per call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base or Solana, no account, no API key); invalid input is refused before payment and a failed run is never charged. Without a payment the tool returns the x402 PaymentRequired. Free sample answer: get_example {"tool":"reality_get_entity"}. Same tool over HTTP: https://yruz.one/api/reality/entity?id=Q7624104

id.description: Wikidata id (required unless q), e.g. Q7624104

properties.description: extra property ids, comma separated, up to 15, e.g. P1056,P2403

q.description: name instead of id (the top search hit is used and reported)

name: reality_get_entity
